record.name: Helen Diller Family Cancer Research Building
names: Helen Diller Family Cancer Research Building
record.summary: A cancer research building of about 164,000 sq ft (SFGate, May 2009; sources differ, see facts) of two interlocking L-shaped, five-story wings (one for wet labs, one for PI/fellow offices), which broke ground in 2006 and celebrated its grand opening in June 2009.

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint, not a hand trace or plan estimate. This is the opposite situation from Mission Bay's condo-mapped residential towers (Avalon, Radiance, etc.): here, ONE large Assessor land parcel spans SEVERAL UCSF buildings (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data and tax roll -- e.g. block/lot 8711507 (675 Mission Bay Blvd in DataSF's parcel data) alone is about 12.2 acres, far larger than any single building on it), so using the parcel boundary per building would make multiple records overlap and double-count the same ground. The real building footprint is the only non-overlapping, honest shape for each one.

facts.value: About 164,000 sq ft (SFGate, May 31, 2009: 'nearly 164,000-square-foot'); the architect's page lists a size of 174,020 with a units label ('gross square meters') that cannot be right for this building, so the figures conflict. The 161,757 sq ft plus 20,000 sq ft of vivarium space earlier shown was not found in any readable source.
Two interlocking L-shaped wings: one wet-lab wing, one PI/fellow office wing

costs.what: "$135 million UCSF cancer research site to open," per SFGate's coverage ahead of the building's grand opening -- described as the facility's overall cost, of which Helen Diller and her husband contributed $35 million to build the center, per the same article

Images: no plan drawing, elevation or openly-licensed photograph was found for this building specifically. Searched: UCSF Real Estate's Mission Bay campus-site and LRDP pages (realestate.ucsf.edu, which could not be checked); the UCSF 2014 LRDP EIR's CEQAnet filing (SCH 2013092047, whose pre-2016 attachments aren't hosted on CEQAnet itself); a May 2000 Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings design-approval item for an early Mission Bay building (text-only, no figures); the 2008 "UCSF Mission Bay Planning Principles" appendix (a citywide-scale community map, no individual buildings labeled); and a UCSF wayfinding campus map (not an adopted plan, EIR or permit filing, so not eligible as public-record even though found). Not pursued further; the record's own project sources above remain the citation for the building's history.

As of 2026-09-29, the UCSF 2009 news release (which could not be checked) is the only source for the grand opening as an event; SFGate's May 31, 2009 article says the building 'officially opens Tuesday' (June 2, 2009) and was written after staff had moved in, and is now cited as well. The size is unresolved: SFGate says nearly 164,000 sq ft, the architect's page says 174,020 (units mislabelled), and 161,757 plus 20,000 sq ft of vivarium space was not found in a readable source.
